name: fix-all-issues
description: Stateful PR review and remediation through fresh background-agent rounds. Keeps the main agent available, binds evidence to exact Git trees, gates fixes through independent triage, publishes repaired rounds, and stops with an explicit clean or capped outcome.

interface.shortDescription: Fresh-context PR review rounds with tree-bound evidence and gated fixes
interface.longDescription: Orchestrate a stateful PR review and fix loop while the main agent stays available. Each outer round gets a fresh coordinator, risk-selected reviewers, verification, independent triage, red-green fixes, validation tied to an exact Git tree, cleanup convergence, normal push, and a fetch-before-edit PR description update. Durable run state tracks original intent, root-cause fingerprints, growth, deployments, and residual risk. Explicit stop outcomes distinguish a clean fresh confirmation from stabilization or a capped run.
defaultPrompt: Review my current branch against main and fix every issue you find
